description: Patch release: adds Hub intake binding for existing local tasks, completes ZCode pull-based adaptation, and hardens Hub lifecycle commands on Windows shells.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(hub): add `suncode hub intake --task` and `--task-json` so an existing local task can bind to a selected Hub requirement without creating a replacement task or overwriting the local PRD.

**Fixes:**
- fix(zcode): complete the ZCode pull-based platform adaptation with research/check/implement agent guidance and CLI adapter support that avoids hook-only behavior.
- fix(hub): make built-in Hub lifecycle hook commands and queued sync retries safe for Windows shells.
notes:
No `--migrate` required.

Run `suncode update` after upgrading to receive refreshed ZCode pull-based guidance and Hub workflow behavior.

Install: `npm install -g @wjptz/suncode`
